provider.name: Census Reporter, using U.S. Census Bureau ACS 2020–2024 5-year detailed tables
provider.geography: ZIP Code Tabulation Area (ZCTA): a Census statistical area, which can differ from the entered USPS ZIP's delivery area.
provider.validation: Every estimate must have the expected table, exact Census Reporter column ID, valid numeric value, geography match, and release name. Null/suppressed values are unavailable, not zero.
provider.attribution: All statistics are 2020–2024 ACS estimates, not 2026 current conditions. Uncertainty margins are not incorporated into derived ratios.
provider.privacy: User ZIP sent on demand to Census Reporter third party and Zippopotam.us; no ZIP stored in Power Atlas logs or shared URLs.
provider.notes: No API key required for Census Reporter documented public endpoint. No scraping, account bypass or paid API. Browsers may block CORS; show source link and clear unavailable state when a request cannot load.

measures.title: Typical gross rent
measures.why: Estimated median monthly gross rent among renter-occupied homes paying cash rent; includes utilities where applicable.
measures.limits: Not the price for a currently advertised rental or proof of a landlord's actions.

measures.title: Median owner-occupied home value
measures.why: Estimated median value for owner-occupied housing.
measures.limits: Not a market appraisal, sale price or home affordability on its own.

housing.missing: Comparable asking rents, housing construction permits, zoning decisions, property ownership and addresses are not verified for this ZCTA.
housing.localAuthority: Zoning, tax and school jurisdictions cannot be resolved solely by ZIP.

measures.title: Households receiving SNAP
measures.why: Share of households that reported receiving food support.
measures.limits: This does not measure the price of groceries or prove food insecurity for individual residents.

measures.title: Residents below poverty threshold
measures.why: Population under the Census poverty threshold (ACS status universe).
measures.limits: Not food prices, current hardship, or a causal policy measure.

groceries.missing: No local grocery basket price series, store concentration panel or price-to-policy causal model is connected.
groceries.localAuthority: State nutrition offices and food programs require jurisdiction and eligibility validation.

measures.title: Homes primarily heated with electricity
measures.why: Occupied housing units reporting electricity as their main heating fuel.
measures.limits: Not the price of a kilowatt-hour or a household utility bill.

measures.title: Homes primarily heated with utility gas
measures.why: Occupied homes using utility gas as their primary heating fuel.
measures.limits: Not a gas tariff, energy efficiency score or price forecast.

energy.missing: No utility-rate tariff, individual energy spending, service territory or specific rate hearing has been matched to the ZIP.
energy.localAuthority: Utility regulation and providers vary by service territory; ZIP alone is insufficient.

measures.title: Residents without health insurance
measures.why: Reported uninsured people across age and sex subgroups, divided by covered population universe.
measures.limits: Not premium amounts, appointment availability or evidence of a policy-caused outcome.

measures.title: Estimated uninsured people
measures.why: Summed reported uninsured subgroups in this area (ACS sample estimate).
measures.limits: Not a count of people denied treatment; summing estimates does not provide exact margin of error.

health.missing: No provider network, insurance plan premium, quality score or patient-specific medical cost is attached.
health.localAuthority: Health insurance eligibility, medical licensing and provider access vary by state and plan.

measures.title: Median household income
measures.why: Middle household's past-year income adjusted to the source's 2024 dollars.
measures.limits: Not individual wages, take-home pay or a current salary estimate.

measures.title: Unemployed share of civilian labor force
measures.why: ACS unemployed residents divided by the civilian labor force.
measures.limits: Not a current monthly BLS unemployment rate, job openings or business layoff proof.

work.missing: No link from federal contractor obligations to specific hiring, wages or business profits in this area.
work.localAuthority: Federal award recipient address does not prove jobs were created locally.

measures.title: Residents enrolled in preschool
measures.why: Residents age 3+ enrolled in nursery school or preschool.
measures.limits: Not preschool supply, price or school assignment.

measures.title: Residents enrolled in school
measures.why: Residents age 3+ enrolled in any school category.
measures.limits: Not school funding, teacher ratios or a district boundary.

schools.missing: No school district assignment, district budget, school test data, childcare fees or provider capacity is joined.
schools.localAuthority: School and childcare service areas require address-level district and license lookups.

measures.title: Commuters using public transit
measures.why: Share of employed residents who reported using public transportation to get to work.
measures.limits: Not live availability, fare prices or an individual's commute.

measures.title: Workers working from home
measures.why: Share of workers who reported working from home.
measures.limits: Not the proportion of jobs allowing remote work today.

transport.missing: No fares, frequencies, travel times, transit-agency budgets, tolls or commute routes are locally verified.
transport.localAuthority: Transit agency routes and service areas can cross municipal and ZIP boundaries.

measures.title: Households without internet access
measures.why: Households reporting no internet access in the ACS.
measures.limits: Not measured broadband price, availability or connection speed.

measures.title: Households without internet access
measures.why: Estimated number of households with no internet access.
measures.limits: Not local government budget allocations or tax burden.

public-services.missing: No local tax bill, municipal budget, school-district finance, expenditure-to-household service outcome is matched.
public-services.localAuthority: Taxes and public services require verified municipal, county, state and district boundaries.

measures.title: Residents in the statistical area
measures.why: Census population estimate for this ZIP Code Tabulation Area.
measures.limits: Not registered voters, all ZIP delivery addresses or constituency membership.

measures.title: Median resident age
measures.why: Estimated median age of residents in the statistical area.
measures.limits: Not voter turnout, eligibility or political leaning.

representation.missing: No verified district crosswalk, elected official, recorded vote, PAC transfer or policy impact attached solely through a ZIP.
representation.localAuthority: ZIPs can cross electoral districts; official address lookup required for representative assignment.

boundaries.fallback: When provider is unavailable the interface shows no local values and links to the original official source; no illustrative or hard-coded location statistics.
